Entry Seals and Thumbprints The illiterate would confirm transactions and promises with a seal, the laying on of hands, or the dictation of witnesses. The bachelor may think this is not accurate enough, but the villagers know that acquaintances and reputation are also reliable credentials; the real danger is not the inability to write, but when someone deliberately takes advantage of someone else's inability to write. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
